Just wanted to share a little bit about my story. I’ve loved fashion since I was little, and having the opportunity to study fashion at DFT Petra @dft.pcu @lifeatpcu taught me so many aspects of the industry from developing concepts and sketching ideas to exploring materials and understanding the design process.

When I started my internship, that was the first time I really experienced how the fashion industry works. I learned so much and was able to contribute with what I had learned from university. Unexpectedly, I was offered the opportunity to continue working at @catherinenjoocouture , which I’m truly grateful for and also met inspiring designer @catherinenjoo Honestly, it feels like I’m living what I once prayed for. I used to wonder what I would be doing after graduating, but God had His own plan, I was even given the opportunity to start working before I finished my studies.

And even now, I’m still learning every day and growing through every experience. ✨

The bronze winner in the same category, Kimberly, created a collection titled “Nyali”, featuring AirPods hook earrings, a multifunctional tie that doubles as a belt, and a heart-shaped ring.

Their visual composition features an astronaut figure and a vibrant, galaxy-inspired color palette. 🚀
